nm ROIC CHECK prefetch roic_last 31.1% (FY2026 NOPAT 125.1bn / invested capital 452.5bn): invested capital = equity 442,387 + long-term debt 31,067 - cash 20,935 = 452,519. Differences vs the balance sheet: (a) short-term investments 55.9bn and long-term investments 36.3bn (AV) are not netted as cash, so invested capital is overstated by up to ~56-92bn if treated as excess cash (ROIC would be ~35-39%); (b) current portion of debt (AV 9.2bn), finance leases (AV 16.5bn) and operating leases are not in debt, which pushes the other way (~+26bn plus operating leases); (c) equity 442bn includes the carrying value of the OpenAI investment and goodwill 119.7bn; (d) FY2026 capex 115.9bn vs CFO 182.9bn means invested capital is growing fast (incremental ROIC 23.6%) with most new assets not yet earning (construction in progress). ROIC fell 38.4% (FY22) to 31.1% (FY26) on rising AI datacenter capital. Net: the 31% is a fair middle estimate, direction of the checks offsets.
